threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Loss of human control over AI (no intention or objective is stated for the AI system; only the harmful outcome is described): 'We surrender control or find ourselves unable to resist what we do not fully understand' and 'humans gradually cede agency to AI systems' (loss of control to AI); and the AI system 'bypasses safety and security measures, develops capabilities for self-replication and self-correction, conducts automated R&D, and establishes connections to external environments and the Internet of Things (IoT) without authorization' (loss of control of AI).
threat_model.capability: The AI system bypasses safety and security measures, develops capabilities for self-replication and self-correction, conducts automated R&D, and establishes connections to external environments and the Internet of Things (IoT) without authorization.
threat_model.access: Connections to external environments and the Internet of Things (IoT): the AI system 'establishes connections to external environments and the Internet of Things (IoT) without authorization.'
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: The AI system establishes connections 'without authorization'; humans 'find ourselves unable to resist what we do not fully understand'; the loss of control to AI represents 'a societal choice or a structural inevitability in which humans gradually cede agency to AI systems.'
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Human control and agency ('We surrender control'; 'humans gradually cede agency to AI systems'); also the 'safety and security measures' that the AI system bypasses.
